issues.what: 11. The accent is tiny and only about half of it is in the top half.
issues.evidence: three_qa accent is 0.2% (as the brief asks) with top half 57.8%, up from 53.2% (the brief says 100%). lineup per-facing is unchanged at [0.05, 0.22, 0.08, 0.1]%. In game (art2_sukri_close.png) the cup and bead hang clear of the body below the HP bar.

issues.evidence: fp2 lineup: base 79.7 / 45.9 / 28.0. The mid band dropped from 46.4 to 45.9, still inside 45-65 but with an even thinner margin. The fix agent attributes this to the new leather elbow cuffs.

issues.what: 16. Stillwater's feet band sits near the 35 cap.
issues.evidence: fp2 lineup: Stillwater bottom band 34.3, up from 34.0. The shins were darkened (#7E8886 -> #767F7D), but other parts pushed the band up. It is still under 35, so the brief's 4 L* trigger does not apply.

issues.evidence: fp2 lineup.log: sukri_shadeprint mid 44.8 (it was 46.2 in lineup4.log) after the print was smoothed. A lineup_qa band miss of 2 L* or less counts as a minor.
